reason: Three loaders test a heap pointer with a signed compare (cmp rN,#0; ble). 32-bit heaps on current Android sit above 0x80000000, so the pointer reads as negative and the load is silently skipped. CMapLayerData::PreLoad then leaves the layer data null and CPdMap::MakeWayPointData segfaults on entering battle. Change ble to beq, keeping the null check.
